results.method_text: Data for block_n were analyzed with a generalized linear mixed model using a Negative Binomial distribution and a log link. Random-effects strategy followed a funnel approach from maximal to random intercept-only when needed. DHARMa diagnostics were used for model validation (uniformity, outliers, residual structure), not as the primary model-selection engine, except when an explicit refit rule is stated. Post-hoc contrasts are FDR-corrected across all DVs (cross-DV Benjamini-Hochberg).
